body: **Foco:** Discourse connectors (nevertheless, furthermore, consequently) — prática e contraste.
**Expressões:** take appropriate measures.
**Pronúncia:** Flap T americano.
**20 palavras novas** (desenvolvimento profissional).
**Texto do dia:** conto e trecho de peça.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (B2):** eu consigo contrastar conectores formais num conto e usar take appropriate measures.

body: Esta aula treina **ouvir e anotar informações (IELTS Listening, TOEFL Listening)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Story: The Late Report
paras: Marta knew the report was late. **Nevertheless**, she did not panic. She **took appropriate measures**: she called her team, **furthermore** she asked the client for one more day.
The client agreed. **Consequently**, the report arrived on time, **although** Marta slept only three hours. **However**, she smiled: the deadline was met.

items.q: The client gave one more day.

head: Conector
Função
Cuidado
rows: **However** pode vir no meio: *She, however, smiled.*

blocks.body: **However** liga duas frases (ponto antes); **although** liga duas orações na mesma frase.

items.s: Marta did not panic; ___ , she acted. (nevertheless)
She called her team; ___ , she asked for a day. (furthermore)
The client agreed; ___ , the report arrived on time. (consequently)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **Take appropriate measures.** — Tomar as medidas adequadas.
**Keep calm and carry on.** — Mantenha a calma e continue.
**Beat the deadline.** — Cumprir o prazo.
**Down to the wire.** — Até o último minuto.
**Save the day.** — Salvar a situação.
**Under pressure.** — Sob pressão.
**Not a moment too soon.** — Na hora H.
**She took appropriate measures.** — Ela tomou as medidas adequadas.
**Consequently, it arrived on time.** — Consequentemente, chegou no prazo.
**The report was late, but Marta didn’t panic.** — O relatório estava atrasado, mas a Marta não entrou em pânico.

blocks.title: After the crisis
lines: The report was late, but Marta didn’t panic.
O relatório estava atrasado, mas a Marta não entrou em pânico.
Furthermore, she asked the client for a day.
Além disso, pediu um dia ao cliente.

items.label: Flap T americano
items.note: No inglês americano, o /t/ entre vogais soa como um /d/ rápido (flap): water, better, city, a lot of.

prompts.model: It was late; nevertheless, she stayed calm.

blocks.task: Write a 6-line story ending with three formal connectors.
blocks.model: The report was late. Nevertheless, Marta stayed calm. She took appropriate measures: she called her team. Furthermore, she asked the client for one more day. Consequently, the report arrived on time. However, she slept only three hours.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
